scripts.start:dev: concurrently -n task-hub,crm-rest,crm-mcp -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter mcp-task-hub run start:dev" "pnpm --filter api-crm run start:dev" "pnpm --filter api-crm run start:mcp-dev"
